response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial project contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in production routing or geospatial data pipelines, and his resume emphasizes JavaScript/TypeScript/DLang over the required systems-level languages and navigation-specific domains.
strengths: Built open-source geospatial platform (GISCollective) with real-world NGO usage
Demonstrated systems-level programming with DLang and low-latency services
Proven ability to learn and contribute across diverse technical stacks
concerns: No explicit C++ or Rust experience in commercial routing or map tile systems
Lack of demonstrated expertise in distributed systems, fault tolerance, or navigation data pipelines
Primary tech stack is JavaScript/TypeScript/DLang, not aligned with C++ as primary requirement
